phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: The entity stands in its standard operating state: a pristine, glass-shelled observer of the simulation, internally lit by the golden pulse of system data. It is a being of pure order, contrasting with the chaotic darkness of the void.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A full-body shot of the Spirit of Heaven, standing perfectly still in a vertical 9:16 composition. The entity's body is made of smoked glass, revealing a glowing skeleton of gold light. It is surrounded by a faint halo of digital noise. The lighting is dramatic and top-down, emphasizing the verticality and the separation from the ground. The background is a deep, matte black, representing the unrendered void of the Upper Store. Photorealistic textures, sharp focus, ISO 100.
